Restrict a bank to a region of parameter space (Route II)

Source: R/restrict.R
restrict_bank.Rd

Defines a latent class as a prespecified region of kinetic-parameter space and recovers its kinetic distribution by restricting an estimated marginal population to that region and renormalising. Because the class prevalence cancels, the population used to build the bank need not consist only of class members, nor share the analysis population's class prevalence.

Usage

restrict_bank(bank, in_region)

Arguments

bank

An mbmm_bank from fit_bank(), or a numeric weight vector.

in_region

Logical vector, one entry per candidate, TRUE for candidates inside the region.

Value

A list with the renormalised weights, the mass the region carried in the marginal, and in_region.

Details

The region must be fixed before any outcome is observed, and must carry population mass bounded away from zero: restriction divides by that mass, so a thin region amplifies any error in the marginal.

References

Result D of the accompanying manuscript.

Examples

set.seed(1)
b <- fit_bank(matrix(rnorm(20 * 6), 20, 6))
restrict_bank(b, in_region = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE))$mass
#> [1] 0.4237955
